none: PAS CAM-D5E775: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, AD335-341, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows two soldiers and one standard. Obverse shows unclear bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.91g, diameter is 15.29mm
